title: Tech Note: Custom User Login
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The classic 4D built-in Password/User/Group system and the default-user + custom-login-dialog pattern described here are still valid for native 4D client/server and standalone apps and remain fully functional in current 4D versions. However, for modern web/ORDA/REST applications, 4D now also offers separate authentication mechanisms (e.g., REST session/force-login options, and third-party/OAuth-based flows), so this note's scope should be understood as specific to the classic desktop/4D Remote login experience, not web app authentication.
related_updates: Classic 4D Password System commands (CHANGE PASSWORD, GET USER LIST, Validate password, CHANGE CURRENT USER) are unchanged and still current
For REST/web apps, 4D has since added additional authentication options (session-based REST auth, OAuth2 patterns) covered in separate later tech notes
